body.heading: Words for things we do
paragraphs: Some words are for doing: run, jump, eat, sleep. Grown-ups call them verbs, but you can call them action words. If you can DO it, it is an action word!
Read each sentence and do the action. Ready?

body.heading: Move your body
paragraphs: I run. I jump. I walk. I sit.
I dance. I play. I sleep. (That last one — just pretend!)

body.heading: Everyday actions
paragraphs: I eat. I drink. I read. I write.
I draw. I listen. I laugh. I cry.

body.heading: The kindest action
paragraphs: Of all the action words on this page, 'help' is Spark's favorite. Helping is an action anyone can do, any day — feeding a pet, carrying a bag, holding a door.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Which action words did you do today already? Tell your day using three of them.
2. Act out an action word silently. Can your family guess it?

takeaway: Action words (verbs) name things we do — run, read, draw, listen — and the kindest one of all is help.
materials: Just you and this page — no materials needed
supervision: A grown-up nearby is recommended for younger readers; the think-and-talk questions work well read aloud together.
safetyNotes: Reading only — no physical activity or materials are involved.
screenFreeExtension: Action-word Simon Says: 'Simon says jump! Simon says listen!' Only move when Simon says.
